notablePrerequisites:
Market Festival attached to a basic land.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
description:
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Market Festival triggers, adding {1}{W}.
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Angel, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.
